name: Scorching Wraps

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +2 Enhancement Bonus : +2 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Flaming Burst
effects.tooltip: Flaming Burst : This weapon is sheathed in fire, and deals 1 to 6 fire damage each hit. Critical hits deal an additional 1 to 10 fire damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 2 to 20 for a x3 multiplier and 3 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.

effects.name: Spiked
effects.tooltip: Spiked : This weapon is studded with vicious spikes, causing it to deal piercing damage in addition to its normal damage types.

effects.name: Bleed
effects.tooltip: Bleed : This weapon is cruelly sharp and will do an additional 1 to 8 damage to targets that are vulnerable to bleeding.

flavor_text: These cloth handwraps, favored by the minotaur brawler Scorchtusk, were enchanted so that his blows will strike with the power of the flame. They're also 'enchanted' with nails. Pointy-ends out.
tips: These handwraps deal Piercing and Bludgeoning damage.
